Tim.archetype: The Four-Category Offensive Juggernaut & Mid-Season Titan
Tim.season_narrative: Dominated hitting across the entire summer, capturing four of the five offensive crowns: 1st in Runs (1297), 1st in Home Runs (385), 1st in RBI (1278), and 1st in Stolen Bases (257), while finishing 2nd in OBP (.3397). Held 1st place from Week 15 through Week 21 and peaked at a season-high 77.5 pts in Week 19 before being narrowly overtaken by Dan in Week 22.

Garrett.archetype: The Cutline Heartbreak & Consolation League Sovereign
Garrett.season_narrative: Fought a dramatic Phase 2 cutline battle against Dan, falling just 2.0 roto points short of the Winners League in Week 14 (56.5 to 58.5). Responded by completely dominating the Consolation League in Phase 3, finishing 5th overall (46.5 pts) with elite power from Rafael Devers (37 HR, 98 RBI) and Brice Turang (95 R, 93 RBI), and tied Tim with 121 Quality Starts.

Dan.archetype: The High-Volume Volume Sweeper & Second-Half Juggernaut
Dan.season_narrative: Mounted the defining campaign of the 2026 season: an epic +31.5 point comeback from 8th place (41.5 pts in Week 1) to claim the #1 overall seed (73.0 pts in Week 23). Dan completely swept all three pitching volume categories (1st in K with 1986, 1st in QS with 135, 1st in SV+HD with 194) while capturing the league OBP crown (.3424) behind James Wood, Shohei Ohtani, and Kazuma Okamoto.

Alex.season_narrative: Overcame a slow Week 1 start (9th, 32.0 pts) to battle in the middle tier, peaking at 40.0 pts in Week 11. Anchored by the single most electrifying individual hitting season in the league: Pete Crow-Armstrong's 41 HR, 111 R, 98 RBI, and 36 SB. Boasted strong starting pitching with Cristopher Sanchez (210 K, 20 QS, 2.79 ERA) and Tarik Skubal, but was hampered by a league-low .3204 OBP.

Will.archetype: The Spring Pace-Setter & Elite WHIP Architect
Will.season_narrative: The league's premier spring force, holding 1st place for 8 separate weeks (Weeks 3-7, 10, 13-14) and peaking at 73.5 pts in Week 13. Engineered the league's top pitching ratio (1st in WHIP at 1.14, 2nd in ERA at 3.53) anchored by Yoshinobu Yamamoto (20 QS, 2.62 ERA), Mason Miller (117 K, 1.14 ERA), and Kyle Schwarber's 44 home runs.

Mark.archetype: The Early Flash & Rotation Quality Workhorse
Mark.season_narrative: Stunned the league with an explosive Week 1 debut at #2 overall (58.5 pts) before entering an offensive dry spell that bottomed at 22.5 pts in Week 18. Despite offensive woes (last in R, HR, RBI, SB), Mark assembled one of the league's most effective starting pitching rotations, finishing 2nd in Quality Starts (124 QS) with Reid Detmers, Michael King, and Paul Skenes.

Preston.archetype: The High-Leverage Relief Specialist & Speed Engine
Preston.season_narrative: Started the year in 5th place (53.0 pts) before enduring a difficult May slump (dropping to 32.0 pts in Week 8). Featured elite base-stealing (3rd in SB with 189) led by Trea Turner and Steven Kwan, along with nasty rotation strikeout anchors Dylan Cease (236 K, 2.38 ERA) and Jacob Misiorowski (148 K, 1.98 ERA in 104 IP), finishing 8th overall at 33.0 pts.

Adrian.archetype: The ERA Champion & Starting Ace Purist
Adrian.season_narrative: Maintained the gold standard for starting rotation quality, winning the league ERA title (3.46) and finishing 2nd in WHIP (1.17) behind front-line aces Chris Sale (2.18 ERA, 190 K), Michael Wacha (20 QS, 3.25 ERA), and Logan Gilbert. Led the league in Weeks 2, 8, and 9 (peaking at 69.5 pts) and locked down the 4th and final Playoff Championship seed.

Anil.archetype: The Opening Week Meteor & Middle-Inning Slugger
Anil.season_narrative: Blazed out of the gate to hold 1st place in Week 1 with 68.5 roto points behind nuclear hitting lines. Sustained immense power all season to finish 2nd in Home Runs (344) with Junior Caminero (40 HR) and Ben Rice (38 HR), but suffered a severe pitching volume drought (last in K with 1330 and last in QS with 68) that dropped him to 6th overall (37.0 pts).

category_battles_2026.title: The Six-Way Decimal War
category_battles_2026.margin_summary: Dan won the crown at .3424 over Tim (.3397). Below them raged a historically chaotic 6-way dogfight separated by less than .003: Will (.3311) vs Anil (.3308, diff .0003), Anil vs Adrian (.3306, diff .0001), Adrian vs Garrett (.3294, diff .0012), Garrett vs Mark (.3284, diff .0011), and Mark vs Preston (.3279, diff .0005).

category_battles_2026.title: The Heavyweight Slugfest & Middle Logjam
category_battles_2026.margin_summary: Tim dominated with 385 homers. Behind Anil (344), five teams finished within 21 homers of each other in a frantic battle for points: Dan (338), Adrian (331), Alex (328), Garrett (325), and Will (323). Garrett and Will were separated by just 2 home runs; Alex and Garrett by 3.

category_battles_2026.title: The High-Leverage Bullpen Duel
category_battles_2026.margin_summary: Dan took the maximum 9.0 points by edging Tim by just 3 saves/holds (194 to 191). Meanwhile, Will (179) edged Adrian (177) by 2 holds, and Alex (131) edged Anil (130) by a single hold/save.

category_battles_2026.title: Quality Starts Dead Heat
category_battles_2026.margin_summary: Dan led the league with 135 QS, followed by Mark's workhorse rotation (124 QS). Tim and Garrett finished in an exact tie for 3rd place with 121 QS each (sharing 6.5 pts). Will finished just 3 back at 118 QS, and Adrian at 113.

category_battles_2026.title: The Speed Sweep & Micro-Margins
category_battles_2026.margin_summary: Tim (257) and Will (233) ran away with the top spots. Down the standings, Preston (189) edged Dan (185) by 4 steals for 7.0 pts, while Alex (165) edged Garrett (164) by a single stolen base.

category_battles_2026.title: The Ratio Dual: Adrian vs Will
category_battles_2026.margin_summary: Adrian captured the ERA crown with 3.46 over Will's 3.53, while Will claimed the WHIP crown at 1.14 over Adrian's 1.17. Behind them, Alex (3.65 ERA) and Anil (3.66 ERA) were separated by just 0.01 in ERA, and Dan (1.20) and Garrett (1.21) traded WHIP points on the season's final weekend.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Opening Week (Trios)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Opening Week exploded with offense as Anil (Yeah Jeets) rocketed to 1st place with 68.5 roto points behind early power surges, followed closely by Mark (58.5 pts). Alex started slow in 9th (32.0 pts).

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 2 (Trios)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Adrian surged into 1st place (61.0 pts) while Will gained +12.0 points behind a dominant pitching week. Anil took an early -11.5 point hit as ratios corrected.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 3 (Trios)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Will seized 1st place for the first time with 67.5 roto points, building a 5.0-point lead over Tim (62.5 pts). Mark suffered a tough -11.5 point swing down into 8th.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 4 (Trios)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Dan posted the biggest single-week jump of the entire 2026 season: an astonishing +13.0 roto points, soaring from 8th to 4th place (57.5 pts). Will defended 1st place (66.0 pts).

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 5 (Trios)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Will (67.5 pts) and Adrian (65.0 pts) established themselves as the premier spring contenders, pulling away from the field. Alex remained in 9th at 33.5 pts.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 6 (Trios)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Will stretched his lead to 68.5 pts, anchored by Yoshinobu Yamamoto and Mason Miller. Dan held 4th place at 51.0 pts.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 7 (Trios)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: A razor-thin spring race: Will (66.5 pts) led Adrian (65.5 pts) by just 1.0 roto point, with Tim lurking in 3rd (58.5 pts).

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 8 (Trios)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Adrian mounted a massive pitching week with Chris Sale and Michael Wacha, taking over 1st place at a season-high 69.5 pts. Preston hit his season trough at 32.0 pts.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 9 (Trios)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Adrian retained 1st place (66.0 pts) over Will (64.5 pts), while Dan climbed back into 4th (57.0 pts). Mark slipped into 9th place (30.0 pts).

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 10 (Trios)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Will reclaimed 1st place (69.0 pts) while Tim surged into 2nd (65.5 pts). Anil endured a -7.5 point drop down to 34.0 pts.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 11 (Trios)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Tim seized 1st place for the first time of the season with 68.0 pts, edging Will (67.0 pts) by 1.0 point. Alex reached his season-high mark of 40.0 pts.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 12 (Trios Finale)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Phase 1 (Trios Marathon) concluded with a photo-finish at the top: Tim took 1st place with 71.5 pts, beating Will (71.0 pts) by 0.5 points! On the Phase 3 cutline, Garrett held 4th (54.5 pts) over Dan (54.0 pts) by just 0.5 points.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Mid-Season Round 1
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Phase 2 (Mid-Season Championship Round 1) ignited the cutline battle: Dan gained +4.0 points to leap into 4th place (58.0 pts), jumping Garrett (54.5 pts). Will regained 1st at a season peak of 73.5 pts.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Mid-Season Round 2
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Phase 2 concluded with monumental playoff implications: Dan secured the 4th and final Winners League seed with 58.5 pts, edging Garrett (56.5 pts) by just 2.0 roto points! Anil hit his season low of 30.0 pts.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 15 (Split Start / ASG)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Phase 3 (Split Leagues Start / ASG) saw the leaderboard reshuffled: Dan gained +8.5 points and Tim gained +7.5 points to take 1st (75.5 pts), while Garrett suffered a -7.5 point drop into the Consolation bracket.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 16 (Split)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Tim extended his dominance at the top with 75.0 pts, while Dan solidified 3rd place with 64.0 pts behind relentless pitching volume.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 17 (Split)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Dan overtook Adrian and Will to grab 2nd place overall (68.5 pts), beginning his direct pursuit of Tim (76.0 pts).

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 18 (Split)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Tim maintained a commanding 5.5-point lead at 75.5 pts over Dan (70.0 pts). Mark bottomed out at a season-low 22.5 pts.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 19 (Split)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Tim hit his season peak of 77.5 roto points, leading Dan (69.0 pts) by an imposing 8.5-point cushion, with four hitting categories firmly in hand.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 20 (Split)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Tim retained his 77.5-point stronghold, but Dan (69.0 pts) and Adrian (65.0 pts) began applying late-summer pressure as starting pitching rotations fatigued.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 21 (Split)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: The gap narrowed dramatically: Dan surged to 71.0 pts while Tim dropped to 75.0 pts — setting up an epic final fortnight for the #1 overall seed.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 22 (Split)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: THE LEADERBOARD FLIP: Dan overtook Tim for 1st place with 72.5 pts to Tim's 72.0 pts! Dan's season-long climb from #8 (41.5 pts) reached the summit.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Week 23 (Regular Season Finale)
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Regular Season Finale: Dan clinched the #1 overall seed with 73.0 roto points, sweeping all three pitching volume categories (K, QS, SV+HD) and OBP (.3424)! Tim finished 2nd (70.5 pts), Will 3rd (66.0 pts), Adrian 4th (60.0 pts), and Garrett ruled Consolation at 46.5 pts.

season_timeline_weeks.name: Playoff Semi-Finals
season_timeline_weeks.narrative: Playoff Semi-Finals: #1 Dan battles #4 Adrian while #2 Tim clashes with #3 Will in head-to-head playoff competition.

championship_bracket.name: Semi-Final A
championship_bracket.storyline: The #1 overall seed Dan, on a +31.5 point regular season surge, faces the league ERA champion Adrian in a clash of volume streaming vs elite rotation ratios.

championship_bracket.name: Semi-Final B
championship_bracket.storyline: The two titans of the regular season spring and summer: Tim's 4-category offensive powerhouse (R, HR, RBI, SB) meets Will's pitching ratio fortress (1st in WHIP, 2nd in ERA, 2nd in K).

consolation_bracket.name: Consolation A
consolation_bracket.storyline: Consolation regular season winner Garrett takes on Preston's high-strikeout rotation (Dylan Cease, Jacob Misiorowski).

consolation_bracket.name: Consolation B
consolation_bracket.storyline: Anil's power tandem of Caminero and Rice battles Alex's Pete Crow-Armstrong powerhouse, separated by just 1.0 regular season roto point.

playoffs_2026.championship_pedigree_context: All four 2026 Championship Semi-Finalists (Dan, Tim, Will, Adrian) are former league champions, representing 11 of the 14 total championships in league history (Tim: 7, Adrian: 2, Will: 1, Dan: 1).
